name: Bloodstone Boar (Figurine of Wondrous Power)
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 11th; Craft Wondrous Item, Spells animate objects.

DESCRIPTION

Tiny bloodlike splotches adorn this dark green spherical stone. When commanded, the figurine transforms into a large, reddish boar with the advanced creature template and faithfully serves you in battle. While carrying the figurine, you are treated as if having the benefits of the Diehard feat. Any time the boar is summoned, you lose this benefit for 24 hours. The boar can be summoned 1/day for up to 2 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells animate objects; Cost 6,250 gp
